subject.title: fix(qa): restore automatic smoke coverage across channels

question: Should maintainers accept re-enabling automatic QA Smoke as three Blacksmith shards plus one fail-closed hosted aggregate once the unrelated failing check is resolved?
rationale: The patch fixes the current smoke-profile owner boundary, but it deliberately changes CI fanout and required-check behavior, which is an operations decision beyond line-level correctness.

options.title: Accept the sharded QA Smoke plan
options.body: Merge after required checks are green, preserving the aggregate `QA Smoke CI` status while letting channel-compatible shards run independently.

options.title: Reduce fanout before merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller or hosted-runner-heavy variant if the three new Blacksmith shard rows are not acceptable for normal node-relevant CI.

options.title: Keep automatic QA Smoke disabled
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer leaving QA Smoke out of automatic CI until a later capacity or proof pass.

recommendation.title: Accept the sharded QA Smoke plan
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks are green, preserving the aggregate `QA Smoke CI` status while letting channel-compatible shards run independently.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and owns the current reviewed head that implements the workflow shape under decision.
